item.title: 🔵 Hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi DNS to steal Microsoft 365 accounts
item.description:
Why this matters: Operational impact possible — watch for changes that generate tickets.
Hackers are changing the DNS settings on Wi-Fi devices at hotels and conference centers to redirect users to fake Microsoft 365 login pages. [...]

Source: BleepingComputer  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
